assertions.name: substrate_closure_vs_codata_within_1_percent
assertions.source: prop:flavor-dressed-mass-from-substrate-split closure: the substrate-pure formula matches CODATA m_n − m_p to within 1% modulo the dropped O((Δm/M_N)²) term. Measured residual at q_0: −0.53% (within the 1% gate).

assertions.name: upper_bound_respected
assertions.source: thm:flavor-mass-splitting-bound: the realised μ_d − μ_u must lie strictly below M_N · ℏ_q² · h_q · [2]_q. Tolerance 0.5 centred at 0.5 admits 0 < ratio < 1; realised value is ~0.33 (33% of bound).

assertions.name: substrate_value_positive
assertions.source: Positivity of substrate factor at q_0 > 1; gives μ_d − μ_u > 0 as required by hadronic physics.

description: Substrate-pure derivation of μ_d − μ_u from prop:flavor-split-substrate (substrate side) + lem:pair-skein-mass-formula (Skein lift).  Reports (a) the substrate-derived value, (b) closure vs CODATA m_n − m_p, and (c) the realised-vs-bound ratio against thm:flavor-mass-splitting-bound.  Calibration discipline: M_N is anchored on CODATA m_p + m_n (validation-tagged); q_0 is the substrate parameter (CAL-2). m_n − m_p itself is NOT an input — it is the derived quantity being predicted.
